name: Platinum Vape | 1g 510 Live Resin | GMO
description:
Earthy, funky, and unapologetically bold. Our Live Resin 510 Cart packs the legendary GMO strain into a potent, flavor-rich experience. Expect that unmistakable garlic-cookie aroma with heavy diesel undertones, balanced by a savory-sweet finish only live resin can capture. This hard-hitting indica delivers deep body relaxation, stress relief, and a long-lasting, sedative calm—perfect for winding down at night or melting away the chaos of the day.

Strain Type: Indica

Flavor Notes: Garlic, diesel, earthy sweet

Effects: Relaxing, sedating, euphoric
